statement: The source method changed from Devon County Council HER Local List layer-10 Exeter bbox querying to Historic England NHLE v02 Listed Building polygons layer 3 for one exact ListEntry (1306502, Bridge Inn). Official Historic England metadata and the NHLE record establish the polygon-layer semantics and explicit inn/public-house identity, but the exact feature payload was not retrievable and direct DNS resolution failed. Source-area/service metadata is retained without parcel/building progress credit; no geometry, area_ha value, or record feature was inferred.
